description: Tracks two things: (1) the Mindwtr cloud server image used by the dockerized integration test -- its version is a bash variable (DEFAULT_CLOUD_TAG in test/integration/run.sh), not a manifest entry, so the custom regex manager extracts it from the '# renovate:' annotation above that line; (2) GitHub Actions versions in .github/workflows. A new cloud tag opens a PR whose CI runs the smoke suite against that version, so the upgrade is validated before merge. enabledManagers keeps Renovate scoped to just these two; remove it to enable every detected manager. ignorePaths is overridden to empty because config:recommended ignores **/test/** by default, which would hide the annotated file above from the file list before the custom manager ever runs.
